about: Real band 68 recordings (guided captures on the bench) that tests/board.mjs replays. For each: when the left and right knocks happened (seconds from the start, a window around the jolt, checked by hand against the capture steps and the band's own tap events), and the distance between the knocks in cm when known (tape-measured, or confirmed by the person; null if not). A new capture with the distance typed in can be added here.

recordings.about: Gentle left knock (0.47 g jumps). A single 0.49 g jump at 11.4 s is the hand setting off toward the right edge, not a knock (one jump; a knock rings for several); the right knock is the 2.85 g one at 12.2 s. The band's tap detector heard only that one, 0.4 s late. On its own board, 50.7 cm between the knocks: the band's own reading, confirmed by the person as accurate (not tape-measured).

Firm knocks (4.3 and 7.7 g peaks); writing with jolts up to 1.6 g, as strong as a gentle knock, which must not be taken for knocks. On its own board, 48.3 cm between the knocks: the band's own reading, confirmed by the person as accurate (not tape-measured).

A single 0.62 g jump at 10.9 s as the hand set off was once taken as the right knock (board 1.9 cm, refused); the knock is at 12.3 s. Held out at the far right, the hand turned 4-10 deg/s and never made a rest by the writing limits, so the edge waited 12 s to be placed. The band sent no tap events at all. On its own board, 39.8 cm between the knocks: the band's own reading, confirmed by the person as accurate (not tape-measured).
